sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def knobTL():
    L = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    cells = [(r,c) for r in range(36,46) for c in range(6,16) if L[r][c]=='N']
    return (min(r for r,c in cells), min(c for r,c in cells))
def redVert():
    for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='R' and n['pixels']==24:
            r0,c0=n['boundary'][0]; r1,c1=n['boundary'][2]
            return (r1-r0)>(c1-c0)
def blueTop():
    for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='b' and n['pixels']==16:
            return n['boundary'][0][0]<30
def done():
    return bool(last_action_result.get('level_completed') or last_action_result.get('done'))
print("start", "redV",redVert(),"blueTop",blueTop(),"knob",knobTL())
# try each arrangement, check completion
for rv,bb in [(True,False),(False,True),(True,True)]:
    if redVert()!=rv: action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':19,'col':48}])
    if (not blueTop())!=bb: action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':36,'col':48}])
    print("arr redV",redVert(),"blueTop",blueTop(),"done?",done())
    if done(): break
print("final done?",done())
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
